plugins.name: agent-credential-leak-surfaces
plugins.description: Find and clean the six local surfaces where a coding agent accumulates copies of your secrets (git remote URLs, memory stores, file-history snapshots, tool config literals, permission allowlists, tool-output caches). Covers why prefix-grep gives false confidence and why keyword-adjacency redaction loses to prose.

plugins.name: prevent-committing-secrets
plugins.description: Block a credential at commit time with a gitleaks pre-commit hook, and cover new repos automatically via init.templateDir. The six paths that skip the hook, where the default ruleset is blind, why a staged-diff scan is not a history scan, and GitHub push protection plus CI as the halves that cannot be bypassed locally.

plugins.name: agent-session-credential-audit
plugins.description: Triage, rotate and scrub credentials that leaked into an agent session transcript. The surfaces a naive scan misses, the false-positive taxonomy, the key-id-vs-secret severity test, non-destructive liveness probes validated with a known-bad control, how to verify a rotation actually rotated, and a kill-list scrub that cannot erase a live secret.

plugins.name: spa-request-capture-and-block
plugins.description: Capture the exact outbound request body a single-page app sends and block it before it leaves the browser: patch window.fetch AND XMLHttpRequest together (the XHR half is the one usually missed, so a fetch-only wrapper lets the request through), read the parsed payload off window, and disarm with a reload — including why a hash-route change does not remove the patch. For actions whose side effect costs credits or creates an irreversible record.
